import java.util.*;

public class Main {

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int w = sc.nextInt();
        int m = sc.nextInt();
        
        int[] a = new int[101];
        
        // Convert m to base-w representation
        for (int i = 0; i <= 100; i++) {
            a[i] = m % w;
            m /= w;
        }
        
        // Process digits with carry
        int carry = 0;
        boolean valid = true;
        
        for (int i = 0; i <= 100; i++) {
            a[i] += carry;
            carry = a[i] / w;
            a[i] %= w;
            
            if (a[i] == 0 || a[i] == 1) {
                continue;
            } else if (a[i] == w - 1) {
                carry = 1;
            } else {
                valid = false;
                break;
            }
        }
        
        System.out.print((valid && carry != 1) ? "YES" : "NO");
    }
}
